title: Dependency pinned to the latest dist-tag
description: package.json declares a dependency pinned to the `latest` dist-tag instead of a version. The tag moves whenever the publisher releases, so a build resolves a different version than the one that was reviewed and tested.
remediation: Replace the dist-tag with the concrete version the project tested.
limitation: It matches a dependency pinned to the `latest` dist-tag instead of a version in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
